# Licences and attributions

## IsiXhosa.click

Adapted from [IsiXhosa.click](https://isixhosa.click/), a student-led dictionary supported by the University of Cape Town and SADiLaR.

[Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0 International (CC BY-SA 4.0)](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/).

Our adaptations include learner-focused glosses, Norwegian translations, usage and contrastive notes, and editorial corrections. Each entry keeps its source and attribution.

The adapted lexicon data is available under the same licence in the [Molo lexicon data package](https://hellomolo.com/lexicon).

## Forvo

[Pronunciation by Forvo](https://forvo.com/). Forvo recordings are used under the Forvo API licence, with attribution on each recording. They are not covered by the lexicon licence.

## Corpus of Spoken isiXhosa

Språkbanken (2025), University of Gothenburg. [Corpus of Spoken isiXhosa](https://doi.org/10.23695/xrsg-mp07). Recorded and annotated in projects led by Eva-Marie Bloom Ström, with Onelisa Slater and Aron Zahran; enriched and distributed by Språkbanken.

[Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (CC BY 4.0)](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). We use the transcriptions for vocabulary frequency and editorial sentence selection, with learner glosses and Norwegian translations. The corpus does not supply our audio.

## NCHLT

[NCHLT isiXhosa Text Corpora](https://hdl.handle.net/20.500.12185/314), Department of Arts and Culture; Centre for Text Technology (CTexT), North-West University, via SADiLaR. Martin Puttkammer, Martin Schlemmer, Wikus Pienaar, Ruan Bekker (2014).

[Creative Commons Attribution 2.5 South Africa (CC BY 2.5 ZA)](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/2.5/za/). We combine its written frequency list with spoken-corpus evidence to rank vocabulary; the source prose is not a model for our lessons.

## Molo assets and curriculum

Original mascots, logo, our own recordings and curriculum: © Hardmax AS. All rights reserved. This reservation does not change the licences of the attributed material above.

## Molo code

Molo’s own application code is licensed under the [GNU Affero General Public License v3.0](https://www.gnu.org/licenses/agpl-3.0.html) (AGPL-3.0). The source is at [github.com/hardmax-as/molo-oss](https://github.com/hardmax-as/molo-oss). Third-party libraries retain their own licences, listed below.

# Lisenser og kildehenvisninger

## IsiXhosa.click

Bearbeidet fra [IsiXhosa.click](https://isixhosa.click/), en studentdrevet ordbok støttet av University of Cape Town og SADiLaR.

[Creative Commons Navngivelse-DelPåSammeVilkår 4.0 Internasjonal (CC BY-SA 4.0)](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/).

Vi har tilpasset ordforklaringene for elever, lagt til norske oversettelser, bruksnotater og sammenligninger mellom språkene, og gjort redaksjonelle rettelser. Hver oppføring beholder kilde og navngivelse.

De bearbeidede leksikondataene er tilgjengelige under samme lisens i [Molos leksikonpakke](https://hellomolo.com/lexicon).

## Forvo

[Pronunciation by Forvo](https://forvo.com/). Forvo-opptak brukes under Forvos API-lisens, med navngivelse på hvert opptak. Leksikonlisensen omfatter ikke disse opptakene.

## Corpus of Spoken isiXhosa

Språkbanken (2025), University of Gothenburg. [Corpus of Spoken isiXhosa](https://doi.org/10.23695/xrsg-mp07). Opptak og annotasjon fra prosjekter ledet av Eva-Marie Bloom Ström, med Onelisa Slater og Aron Zahran; beriket og distribuert av Språkbanken.

[Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (CC BY 4.0)](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Vi bruker transkripsjonene til ordfrekvens og redaksjonelt utvalg av setninger, med ordforklaringer tilpasset elever og norske oversettelser. Korpuset leverer ikke lyden vår.

## NCHLT

[NCHLT isiXhosa Text Corpora](https://hdl.handle.net/20.500.12185/314), Department of Arts and Culture; Centre for Text Technology (CTexT), North-West University, via SADiLaR. Martin Puttkammer, Martin Schlemmer, Wikus Pienaar, Ruan Bekker (2014).

[Creative Commons Attribution 2.5 South Africa (CC BY 2.5 ZA)](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/2.5/za/). Vi kombinerer den skriftlige frekvenslisten med data fra talekorpuset for å rangere ordforråd; kildetekstene er ikke en modell for leksjonene våre.

## Molos materiale og læreplan

Originale maskoter, logo, våre egne opptak og læreplan: © Hardmax AS. Alle rettigheter forbeholdt. Dette endrer ikke lisensene til det navngitte materialet ovenfor.

## Molo-kode

Molos egen appkode er lisensiert under [GNU Affero General Public License v3.0](https://www.gnu.org/licenses/agpl-3.0.html) (AGPL-3.0). Kildekoden ligger på [github.com/hardmax-as/molo-oss](https://github.com/hardmax-as/molo-oss). Tredjepartsbiblioteker beholder sine egne lisenser, som er oppført nedenfor.
